title: Recurring issues and unresolved complaints
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe recurring or unresolved problems, with only a few examples saying there were no issues or that the owner was enjoying the car.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention enjoying the car and not having issues so far, but the examples are few and one fragment is only indirect context about prior vehicles.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe multiple recurring problems, issues appearing early, concerns that remain unresolved, and scattered complaints about cost, features, or general dissatisfaction.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dealer resolution expectations or slow resolution timing without enough context to tell whether the customer viewed the outcome positively or negatively.

signal_notes.interpretation: BEVE examples in this topic are associated with unresolved or issue-focused language similar to the rest of the topic, with only a small difference from non-BEVE examples.
US examples dominate the sample and mostly contain issue-focused complaints, but the non-US comparison group is small.
ICE examples show issue-focused complaints at a level similar to non-ICE examples rather than a distinct pattern.

limitations: This topic is somewhat heterogeneous because 'issue' language ranges from unresolved defects to cost concerns, feature-specific complaints, and vague mentions without enough detail.
Several fragments are too short or generic to identify the underlying product area, and one negative example says 'the issue was resolved' despite being sentiment-labeled negative.
The examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback.
